name: first-five-fist-presentation
description: Checks actual first-five native geometry and final oriented bounds; real Shop, Inventory, equipped part/color/material parity; static camera/model identity; closed/offscreen Shop release and bounded repeated menu lifecycle. Repeat under desktop and phone emulation; does not claim phone FPS or artistic approval. Verifies all part bounds against preview frusta, resizes desktop to 900x600 and checks same-model viewport refitting.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='Smash Fist QA Desktop Resize' workspace:SetAttribute('SmashFistQAOriginalDevice',S:GetDeviceAsync() or '') local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1277,Height=720,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() assert(r.X==1277 and r.Y==720,'desktop simulator resolution mismatch') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
c:Invoke('Reset')
local budget=1 for _,def in ipairs(G.Fists) do budget+=def.cost end
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=budget,Power=1000,Depth=75,WallLevel=99})
for _,def in ipairs(G.Fists) do if def.cost>0 then local r=c:Invoke('BuyFist',def.name) assert(r.ok==true,'buy failed '..def.name..' '..H:JSONEncode(r)) end end
for _,def in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do local r=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumFist',def.name) assert(r.ok==true,'grant failed '..def.name..' '..H:JSONEncode(r)) end
local owned=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedFistsJSON.Value)
local all=G.AllFists() assert(#all==#G.Fists+#G.PremiumFists,'combined catalog count drift')
for _,def in ipairs(all) do assert(table.find(owned,def.name),'not owned '..def.name) end
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,ownedCount=#all,normalCount=#G.Fists,premiumCount=#G.PremiumFists})

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local G=require(RS.GameConfig)
local B=require(RS.FistVisualBuilder)
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
local remote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local firstNames={'Starter Glove','Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}
local function definition(name) for _,d in ipairs(G.AllFists()) do if d.name==name then return d end end error('missing definition '..name) end
local function untilReady(callback,message,seconds)
 local deadline=os.clock()+(seconds or 5)
 repeat local result=callback() if result then return result end task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline
 error(message)
end
local function visible(object)
 local node=object
 while node and node~=p.PlayerGui do
  if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end
  if node:IsA('ScreenGui') and not node.Enabled then return false end
  node=node.Parent
 end
 return object:IsDescendantOf(p.PlayerGui)
end
local function catalogModels(root)
 local result={}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
  if d:IsA('Model') and d:GetAttribute('FistCatalogVisual')==true and d:FindFirstChild('Catalog Closed Palm') then table.insert(result,d) end
 end
 return result
end
local function parts(root)
 local result={}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then assert(not result[d.Name],'duplicate part '..d.Name) result[d.Name]=d end end
 return result
end
local function closeVector(actual,expected,epsilon) return (actual-expected).Magnitude<=(epsilon or .003) end
local function colorNear(a,b) return math.max(math.abs(a.R-b.R),math.abs(a.G-b.G),math.abs(a.B-b.B))<=1/255 end
local function actualBounds(root,frame)
 local low=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge)
 local high=Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge)
 for _,part in pairs(parts(root)) do
  for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
   local corner=frame:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)*.5))
   low=Vector3.new(math.min(low.X,corner.X),math.min(low.Y,corner.Y),math.min(low.Z,corner.Z))
   high=Vector3.new(math.max(high.X,corner.X),math.max(high.Y,corner.Y),math.max(high.Z,corner.Z))
  end end end
 end
 return low,high
end
local function verifyVisualHazards(model,preview,hand)
 for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
  assert(not d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') and not d:IsA('Tool') and not d:IsA('RemoteEvent') and not d:IsA('RemoteFunction') and not d:IsA('BindableEvent') and not d:IsA('BindableFunction') and not d:IsA('ClickDetector') and not d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') and not d:IsA('Sound') and not d:IsA('Humanoid') and not d:IsA('Animator') and not d:IsA('AnimationController') and not d:IsA('BodyMover') and not d:IsA('JointInstance'),'unsafe visual descendant '..d.ClassName)
  if d:IsA('WeldConstraint') then
   assert(not preview and d.ClassName=='WeldConstraint' and d.Enabled==true,'unapproved visual weld')
   local first,second=d.Part0,d.Part1
   local valid=hand and first and second and ((first:IsA('BasePart') and first:IsDescendantOf(model) and second==hand) or (second:IsA('BasePart') and second:IsDescendantOf(model) and first==hand))
   assert(valid,'wrong wrist weld endpoints')
  else
   assert(not d:IsA('Constraint'),'unapproved visual constraint '..d.ClassName)
  end
  if preview then
   assert(not d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and not d:IsA('Trail') and not d:IsA('Beam') and not d:IsA('Light') and not d:IsA('Highlight'),'effect/physics in preview '..d.ClassName)
  end
 end
end
local function verifyGeometry(model,def,preview)
 assert(model and model:GetAttribute('FistCatalogVisual')==true,'missing real catalog model '..def.name)
 assert(model:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==def.name and model:GetAttribute('CatalogGeometryVersion')=='SharedClosedFistV1','catalog identity mismatch '..def.name)
 local spec=assert(B.GetCatalogSpec(def))
 local all=parts(model)
 local palm=assert(all['Catalog Closed Palm'],'missing palm')
 local basePalm
 for _,part in ipairs(spec.parts) do if part.name=='Catalog Closed Palm' then basePalm=part end end
 local scale=palm.Size.X/basePalm.size.X
 assert(scale>0,'invalid uniform scale')
 local count,roles=0,{}
 for _ in pairs(all) do count+=1 end
 assert(count==#spec.parts and count>=12 and count<=22,'extra/missing catalog geometry '..def.name)
 for _,expected in ipairs(spec.parts) do
  local part=assert(all[expected.name],'missing '..expected.name)
  local relative=palm.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
  local canonical=basePalm.cframe:ToObjectSpace(expected.cframe)
  assert(part.ClassName=='Part' and part.Shape==expected.shape,'shape mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(closeVector(part.Size/scale,expected.size),'size mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(closeVector(relative.Position/scale,canonical.Position,.006),'offset mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(relative.UpVector:Dot(canonical.UpVector)>.999 and relative.LookVector:Dot(canonical.LookVector)>.999,'rotation mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(colorNear(part.Color,expected.color) and part.Material==expected.material,'color/material mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(part:GetAttribute('FistShape')==expected.role,'anatomy role mismatch '..expected.name)
  roles[expected.role]=(roles[expected.role] or 0)+1
  assert(part.Massless and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery and not part.CastShadow,'physical visual '..expected.name)
  assert(part.Anchored==preview,'unexpected anchoring '..expected.name)
 end
 assert(roles.ClosedPalm==1 and roles.ClosedKnuckle==4 and roles.CurledFinger==4 and roles.FoldedThumb==1 and roles.WristCuff==1 and roles.BackhandPlate==1,'incomplete closed anatomy')
 assert(model:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')==count and model:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true,'part count metadata drift')
 verifyVisualHazards(model,preview,not preview and p.Character and (p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')) or nil)
 return count,scale
end
local function equipped(def)
 remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target=def.name})
 return untilReady(function()
  local model=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet')
  if p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==def.name and model and model:GetAttribute('DisplayName')==(def.displayName or def.name) and model:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true then return model end
 end,'equip did not reach ready state '..def.name)
end
local rows,signatures={},{}
for _,name in ipairs(firstNames) do
 local def=definition(name)
 local model=assert(B.BuildCatalogModel(def))
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local count=verifyGeometry(model,def,true)
  local low,high=actualBounds(model,CFrame.identity)
  local boundsCenter,boundsSize=model:GetBoundingBox()
  assert(closeVector(boundsSize,high-low) and closeVector(boundsCenter.Position,(low+high)*.5),'actual bounds disagree with engine bounds')
  assert(closeVector(model:GetAttribute('CatalogBoundsSize'),high-low) and closeVector(model:GetAttribute('CatalogBoundsCenter'),(low+high)*.5),'stale final bounds metadata')
  assert(model:GetPivot().Position.Magnitude<.001,'wrist origin moved')
  assert(low.Y>=-.11 and high.Y<=1.6 and (high-low).X<=1.5 and (high-low).Z<=1.3,'unbounded canonical fist')
  local ordered={} for _,part in pairs(parts(model)) do table.insert(ordered,part) end table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)return a.Name<b.Name end)
  local signature='' for _,part in ipairs(ordered) do signature..=string.format('%s:%.4f,%.4f,%.4f:%.4f,%.4f,%.4f;',part.Shape.Name,part.Size.X,part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z,part.Position.X,part.Position.Y,part.Position.Z) end
  assert(not signatures[signature],'identical geometry without color/labels') signatures[signature]=true
  return {name=name,parts=count,width=high.X-low.X,height=high.Y-low.Y,depth=high.Z-low.Z}
 end)
 model:Destroy()
 assert(ok,result) table.insert(rows,result)
end
assert(B.GetCatalogSpec(nil)==nil and B.BuildCatalogModel({name='Magma Breaker'})==nil,'unsupported fallback contract')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=#rows==5,count=#rows,uniqueActualGeometry=5,rows=rows})

local function verifyPreviewProjection(viewport,model)
 local camera=assert(viewport.CurrentCamera,'preview camera unavailable')
 local size=viewport.AbsoluteSize
 assert(size.X>0 and size.Y>0,'preview viewport has no area')
 local tangentY=math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local tangentX=tangentY*size.X/size.Y
 local maxX,maxY,samples=0,0,0
 for _,part in pairs(parts(model)) do
  for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
   local point=camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)*.5))
   local depth=-point.Z
   assert(depth>0,'preview geometry behind camera')
   maxX=math.max(maxX,math.abs(point.X)/(depth*tangentX))
   maxY=math.max(maxY,math.abs(point.Y)/(depth*tangentY))
   samples+=1
  end end end
 end
 assert(samples>=96,'preview projection did not inspect actual parts')
 assert(maxX<=1+2/size.X and maxY<=1+2/size.Y,'preview geometry clipped: '..H:JSONEncode({width=size.X,height=size.Y,maxX=maxX,maxY=maxY}))
 return {width=size.X,height=size.Y,maxX=maxX,maxY=maxY,samples=samples,insideViewport=true}
end
local function equipped(def)
 remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target=def.name})
 return untilReady(function()
  local model=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet')
  if p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==def.name and model and model:GetAttribute('DisplayName')==(def.displayName or def.name) and model:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true then return model end
 end,'equip did not reach ready state '..def.name)
end
local rows={}
for _,name in ipairs(firstNames) do
 local def=definition(name)
 a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Fists')
 local shop=untilReady(function()return g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild('FunctionalHeroShop')end,'Shop missing')
 local card=assert(shop:FindFirstChild(name..'ShopCard',true),'Shop card missing '..name)
 local scroll=assert(shop:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll',true),'Shop scroll missing')
 scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,card.AbsolutePosition.Y-scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroll.CanvasPosition.Y-12))
 local viewport=untilReady(function()
  local icon=card:FindFirstChild('ProductArt')
  local v=icon and icon:FindFirstChild('FistCatalogPreview')
  if v and visible(v) and #catalogModels(v)==1 then return v end
 end,'visible Shop catalog preview missing '..name)
 assert(viewport:IsA('ViewportFrame') and viewport.CurrentCamera and viewport.AbsoluteSize.X>=36 and viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y>=36,'unusable Shop stage')
 assert(viewport:GetAttribute('RenderLoop')==false and viewport:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==name,'Shop preview static identity missing')
 local shopModel=catalogModels(viewport)[1]
 local shopParts=verifyGeometry(shopModel,def,true)
 local shopProjection=verifyPreviewProjection(viewport,shopModel)
 local palm=shopModel:FindFirstChild('Catalog Closed Palm') local pose,camera=palm.CFrame,viewport.CurrentCamera.CFrame
 task.wait(.3)
 assert(palm.Parent and palm.CFrame==pose and viewport.CurrentCamera.CFrame==camera,'Shop preview rotates or rebuilds while idle')
 a:Invoke('OpenInventory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Fists') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','fist:'..name)
 local detail=assert(g:FindFirstChild('InventoryDetail',true),'Inventory detail missing')
 local inventoryModel=untilReady(function()
  for _,m in ipairs(catalogModels(detail)) do if m:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==name then return m end end
 end,'Inventory model missing '..name)
 local invViewport=inventoryModel:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ViewportFrame')
 assert(invViewport and visible(invViewport) and invViewport.CurrentCamera,'hidden Inventory preview '..name)
 local inventoryParts=verifyGeometry(inventoryModel,def,true)
 local inventoryProjection=verifyPreviewProjection(invViewport,inventoryModel)
 local invPalm=inventoryModel:FindFirstChild('Catalog Closed Palm') local invPose,invCamera=invPalm.CFrame,invViewport.CurrentCamera.CFrame
 a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem','fist:'..name) task.wait(.3)
 assert(invPalm.Parent and invPalm.CFrame==invPose and invViewport.CurrentCamera.CFrame==invCamera,'same selected item recreated or rotated')
 local model=equipped(def)
 local hand=assert(p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm'))
 verifyVisualHazards(model,false,hand)
 assert(model:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='ItemMatchedClosedFistV3' and model:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='SharedCatalogGeometry','equipped source mismatch')
 assert(model:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==name and model:GetAttribute('CatalogGeometryVersion')=='SharedClosedFistV1','outer identity mismatch')
 local catalogs=catalogModels(model) assert(#catalogs==1,'expected one equipped catalog child')
 local equippedParts,scale=verifyGeometry(catalogs[1],def,false)
 assert(shopParts==inventoryParts and inventoryParts==equippedParts,'cross-surface part count drift')
 rows[#rows+1]={name=name,shopParts=shopParts,inventoryParts=inventoryParts,equippedParts=equippedParts,scale=scale,geometryParity=true,shopProjection=shopProjection,inventoryProjection=inventoryProjection}
 a:Invoke('CloseMenus') task.wait(.15)
 assert(#catalogModels(shop)==0,'closed Shop retained live fist models')
end
return H:JSONEncode({ok=#rows==5,count=#rows,geometryParity=true,rows=rows})

  if d:IsA('WeldConstraint') then

local function verifyGeometry(model,def,preview)
 assert(model and model:GetAttribute('FistCatalogVisual')==true,'missing real catalog model '..def.name)
 assert(model:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==def.name and model:GetAttribute('CatalogGeometryVersion')=='SharedClosedFistV1','catalog identity mismatch '..def.name)
 local spec=assert(B.GetCatalogSpec(def))
 local all=parts(model)
 local palm=assert(all['Catalog Closed Palm'],'missing palm')
 local basePalm
 for _,part in ipairs(spec.parts) do if part.name=='Catalog Closed Palm' then basePalm=part end end
 local scale=palm.Size.X/basePalm.size.X
 assert(scale>0,'invalid uniform scale')
 local count,roles=0,{}
 for _ in pairs(all) do count+=1 end
 assert(count==#spec.parts and count>=12 and count<=22,'extra/missing catalog geometry '..def.name)
 for _,expected in ipairs(spec.parts) do
  local part=assert(all[expected.name],'missing '..expected.name)
  local relative=palm.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
  local canonical=basePalm.cframe:ToObjectSpace(expected.cframe)
  assert(part.ClassName=='Part' and part.Shape==expected.shape,'shape mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(closeVector(part.Size/scale,expected.size),'size mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(closeVector(relative.Position/scale,canonical.Position,.006),'offset mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(relative.UpVector:Dot(canonical.UpVector)>.999 and relative.LookVector:Dot(canonical.LookVector)>.999,'rotation mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(colorNear(part.Color,expected.color) and part.Material==expected.material,'color/material mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(part:GetAttribute('FistShape')==expected.role,'anatomy role mismatch '..expected.name)
  roles[expected.role]=(roles[expected.role] or 0)+1
  assert(part.Massless and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery and not part.CastShadow,'physical visual '..expected.name)
  assert(part.Anchored==preview,'unexpected anchoring '..expected.name)
 end
 assert(roles.ClosedPalm==1 and roles.ClosedKnuckle==4 and roles.CurledFinger==4 and roles.FoldedThumb==1 and roles.WristCuff==1 and roles.BackhandPlate==1,'incomplete closed anatomy')
 assert(model:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')==count and model:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true,'part count metadata drift')

end
local function verifyPreviewProjection(viewport,model)
 local camera=assert(viewport.CurrentCamera,'preview camera unavailable')
 local size=viewport.AbsoluteSize
 assert(size.X>0 and size.Y>0,'preview viewport has no area')
 local tangentY=math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local tangentX=tangentY*size.X/size.Y
 local maxX,maxY,samples=0,0,0
 for _,part in pairs(parts(model)) do
  for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
   local point=camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)*.5))
   local depth=-point.Z
   assert(depth>0,'preview geometry behind camera')
   maxX=math.max(maxX,math.abs(point.X)/(depth*tangentX))
   maxY=math.max(maxY,math.abs(point.Y)/(depth*tangentY))
   samples+=1
  end end end
 end
 assert(samples>=96,'preview projection did not inspect actual parts')
 assert(maxX<=1+2/size.X and maxY<=1+2/size.Y,'preview geometry clipped: '..H:JSONEncode({width=size.X,height=size.Y,maxX=maxX,maxY=maxY}))
 return {width=size.X,height=size.Y,maxX=maxX,maxY=maxY,samples=samples,insideViewport=true}
end

assert(shop:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='DesktopCatalogV2','narrow desktop regression unexpectedly used phone layout')
local rows={}
for _,name in ipairs(firstNames) do
 local def=definition(name)
 local card=assert(shop:FindFirstChild(name..'ShopCard',true))
 local scroll=assert(shop:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll',true))
 scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,card.AbsolutePosition.Y-scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroll.CanvasPosition.Y-12))
 local viewport=untilReady(function()local icon=card:FindFirstChild('ProductArt') local v=icon and icon:FindFirstChild('FistCatalogPreview') if v and visible(v) and #catalogModels(v)==1 then return v end end,'narrow desktop preview missing '..name)

 local originalSize,originalWidth=viewport.Size,viewport.AbsoluteSize.X

  viewport.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.72,1)
  untilReady(function()return viewport.AbsoluteSize.X<originalWidth-1 end,'viewport resize did not settle')
  task.wait(.15)
  assert(model.Parent and catalogModels(viewport)[1]==model,'resizing rebuilt the preview model')
  return verifyPreviewProjection(viewport,model)
 end)
 viewport.Size=originalSize
 untilReady(function()return math.abs(viewport.AbsoluteSize.X-originalWidth)<1 end,'viewport restore did not settle')
 task.wait(.15)
 assert(ok,result)

 rows[#rows+1]={name=name,before=before,resized=result,restored=restored,sameModel=true}
end
